_README: Manual owner-tenure overrides. Override the season-start-owner rule from src_weekly_franchise_summary when D1's owner_name field doesn't match the league's actual owner-of-record (typically because D1 ETL stamped current owner onto historical weekly rows OR because there was a managed-vs-owned distinction). Keyed by franchise_id → list of owner-tenure entries. Each entry has owner_name + tenure_start_season (inclusive). Tenure_end_season is optional (defaults to ongoing).
_last_updated_by: Keith (2026-05-22 ruling: 'managed' ≠ 'owner of record' — season-start owner gets the W/L attribution)
_logic: Rebuilder reads this file and trims owner_seasons to only include seasons >= tenure_start_season for the matching (franchise_id, owner_name) pair. Seasons before tenure_start_season are still attributed to the franchise but not to this owner.

0006.notes: Brian managed 0006 from mid-2024 (week 15 swap) but Josh Lima retains attribution of 2024 W/L stats per Keith 2026-05-22 (commish ruling: season-start owner gets the season). Brian's career as owner-of-record starts 2025.
